data.name: Shatakshi
data.gender_notes: Shatakshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge and power. She is also known as the goddess of eyes and the one who has a thousand eyes. She is the deity of the sun and the destroyer of darkness. The name Shatakshi carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shatakshi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shatakshi is a representation of divine wisdom and power. She is the one who can see through all the illusions of life and guide us to the truth.
data.etymology: Shatakshi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wisdom and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shatakshi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shatakshi is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and culture. This goddess is considered as a symbol of power, knowledge, and wisdom, with her thousand eyes representing the all-seeing nature of the divine. In various Hindu scriptures and folklore, she is often depicted as a sun goddess or related to Surya, a prominent deity in Hinduism. Additionally, her association with the eyes signifies the importance given to the power of sight, as well as good vision, in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Shatakshi holds significance as a reminder of the omniscience and all-knowing nature of the divine. It serves as an inspiration towards seeking knowledge and gaining wisdom, as the goddess herself embodies these qualities. Furthermore, her connection to the sun represents the idea of illuminating one's own path through knowledge and self-awareness. Thus, invoking the name Shatakshi can serve as a reminder to focus on gaining knowledge, insight, and wisdom to lead a more enlightened and spiritually fulfilling life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shatakshi, meaning 'Having a Hundred Eyes', symbolizes all-knowing wisdom and enlightenment. It embodies the power to see beyond the physical world, into the depths of consciousness and the mysteries of the universe.

vedic_reference.note: One of the many forms of Lord Shiva, symbolizing omniscience and omnipresence.
